rules.statement: The concept of prior registration applies in respect of an undivided share in terms of Section 7 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: The concept of priority as contained in Section 7(1) of the Registration of Documents Ordinance, does not apply to an undivided share and therefore the subsequent transfer, even though duly registered, does not gain priority and will not confer any title since the owner has in fact transferred his title by the earlier instrument, although it was not duly registered.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 7 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance
